Usage: galaxy-cli tool run [OPTIONS] TOOL_ID

  Run a tool with given inputs.

  Inputs can be provided two ways:
    -i key=value           (one flag per parameter, simple values)
    --inputs-json file.json (entire input dict, supports nesting)

  Both can be combined; -i flags override matching keys from --inputs-json.

  Parameter encoding rules (Galaxy native format):
    • Datasets:     -i input=hda:DATASET_ID  (or just the dataset id)
    • Collections:  -i input=hdca:COLLECTION_ID
    • Nested dataset/collection JSON may use {"src":"hda","id":"DATASET_ID"}
      or {"src":"hdca","id":"COLLECTION_ID"}
    • Booleans:     -i some_flag=true        (use true / false, not yes/no)
    • Repeat blocks use pipe syntax with a 0-based index per item:
          -i operations_0|op_name=mean
          -i operations_0|op_column=2
          -i operations_1|op_name=sum
          -i operations_1|op_column=3
    • Conditionals are flattened the same way:

import json,re
from openpyxl import load_workbook
ds=json.load(open('/workspace/copy_datasets.json'))
exomes=[d['name'] for d in ds if d['name'].startswith('230209_Exome')]
wb=load_workbook('/workspace/tmp/230215_Trio_Status.xlsx', read_only=True, data_only=True)
rows=[]
for i,row in enumerate(wb['Sheet1'].iter_rows(values_only=True)):
    if i==0: continue
    sid=str(row[0]).strip()
    status=row[1]
    blm=row[3]
    rows.append((sid,status,blm))
# map by tokens in filename
import re
missing=[]
for sid,status,blm in rows:
    base=str(sid)
    # sample id may include suffix; find any exome containing sample token
    matches=[e for e in exomes if re.search(rf'CHIP_{re.escape(base)}[-_]', e)]
    if not matches:
        missing.append((sid,status,blm))
print('trios',len(rows),'exomes',len(exomes))
print('missing exome rows',missing)
carriers=[r for r in rows if r[2]=='Carrier']
print('carriers',len(carriers))
for r in carriers:
    matches=[e for e in exomes if re.search(rf'CHIP_{re.escape(r[0])}[-_]', e)]
    print(r,matches)
# any exome not in trios
ex_tokens=[]
for e in exomes:
    m=re.search(r'CHIP_(["'^.-]+)'"',e)
    ex_tokens.append(m.group(1) if m else e)
unmatched=[(e,t) for e,t in zip(exomes,ex_tokens) if not any(r[0]==t for r in rows)]
print('exomes unmatched to trio sample id',unmatched)
PY"
